title: X-caliber - Le Miserables (Don't Make It so Hard)

lines.l: Oh baby, it's so hard on me baby
Two lives contained inside of one man's mind
Nearly invisible, intangibles, we lead the life that's miserable
The misery a sideshow, rhyming with my eyes closed
Feeling in the dark reaching out, so where'd my life go?
I might go psycho if the scenes don't change
Feeling like my life's a book and nobody turned the page
So I maintain the simple status I keep
But then again I think I'm blessed just to walk these streets
Lowell, home of the trife, landed the grave
Cause nowadays, these migratory paths are all paved
Lower life, no city, it's a pity
But the fact is, cross the wrong become target practice
Kids playing rocks, clack, clack, shoot dice
Their style's crystal, but our style's just nice
In my past life, I must've led the fast life
Cause I wanna take it slower now, just be a poet now
Knowing how, these bird traps get set
So I speak the revelations over wax and cassette
To cash checks, hooked up beats
Making music, kept my ass off the streets
Unless I'm in a cypher with my peeps
Low budget apparel, trying to get this dat
Living life like hip hop, cause I'm starting from scratch
We keep it laced with the trace of the past
The history, the misery, they miserable, I'm home at last
They miserable
I want it all like slob, but how can I when I can barely get by
And all the music makes me high
I keep producing concepts, hush, hush
A rubber don't say much
But on some other shit when keys get touched
There's too much on my mind
For too many words
Just try to maintain
And just rock like steady
Life is a struggle when you're lonely
So I made this mic my wife, my one and only
Struck from Cupid's hip-hop barrel from the start
About to give him a heart till death do his part
And so far it's love, love, love you
Like Thurston Howell
Cause an eye for an eye
Leaves and seas without a vowel
Forget crystal jewels and rhinestones
We dreamin' NPCs and gold microphones
It's my destiny, fulfilling of the prophecy
The legacy, I live inside the mills that be possessin' me
My history, my family tree came from
Representin' the Hellenic city streets all from
The devil's rum we be sippin', trippin' until we tipsy
The lyrical gypsies embellishin' in Scott's whiskey
So who's got the keys to cheese?
Let's take this ride to the poison store
For more liquor to pour
We find a consolation in a cup of red wine
Reflecting on our lifetimes, watching the moonshine
We'll be right back.
